Pain points (challenges or problems they want to solve)

For example, if Tarsier Optics is selling high-end binoculars, their ideal persona might be someone passionate about wildlife or birdwatching, likely middle-aged, with disposable income and an interest in premium outdoor gear. In contrast, a different persona might represent a younger, more budget-conscious buyer who doesn’t prioritize high-tech features but values convenience or compactness.

To score this comparison:

A 10/10 means both personas are essentially the same, with overlapping needs, behaviors, and demographics.

A 1/10 means they're worlds apart, targeting totally different types of buyers with no overlap in their approach.
